MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document)
WITH p, strptime(p.birth_date, '%Y/%m/%d') AS birth, strptime(COALESCE(p.death_date, '2026/10/14'), '%Y/%m/%d') AS reference_date
WITH p,
     date_part('year', reference_date) - date_part('year', birth) -
     CASE
       WHEN date_part('month', reference_date) < date_part('month', birth)
         OR (date_part('month', reference_date) = date_part('month', birth)
             AND date_part('day', reference_date) < date_part('day', birth))
       THEN 1 ELSE 0
     END AS age
WHERE age < 78
RETURN DISTINCT p.position AS col1, p.nationality AS col2, age AS col3, p.name AS name_player

WITH p,
     CAST(SUBSTRING(p.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INT64) AS birth_year,
     CAST(SUBSTRING(p.birth_date, 6, 1 + CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(p.birth_date, 7, 1) = '/' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS INT64) AS birth_month,
     CAST(SUBSTRING(p.birth_date, 8, 2) AS INT64) AS birth_day,
     COALESCE(p.death_date, '2026/10/14') AS ref_date
WITH p, birth_year, birth_month, birth_day,
     CAST(SUBSTRING(ref_date, 1, 4) AS INT64) AS ref_year,
     CAST(SUBSTRING(ref_date, 6, 1 + CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(ref_date, 7, 1) = '/' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS INT64) AS ref_month,
     CAST(SUBSTRING(ref_date, 9, 2) AS INT64) AS ref_day
WITH p,
     ref_year - birth_year - CASE
       WHEN ref_month < birth_month OR (ref_month = birth_month AND ref_day < birth_day) THEN 1
       ELSE 0
     END AS age
WHERE age < 78
RETURN DISTINCT p.position AS col1, p.nationality AS col2, age AS col3, p.name AS name_player
